candidate_grammar.boundary: All exact post-seal comparisons between the forced positive integer exponent and the complete finite positive exponent interval reported by the registered primary experiment.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete product of physical carrier, inverse-square relation, provenance, capability-closed prediction, separate measurement record, complete rows, positive-successor closure and no-extra-rule forms.

logarithm, regression, floating fit or best-match selection in the checker

claim that interval agreement proves an exact physical value
intended_certificate: One survivor from 256 comparison forms, independent grammar regeneration, exact positive-integer census of the complete reported interval, hostile controls and a source-bound empirical receipt.
statement: After the Fold structure independently forces and seals positive integer exponent two, the Williams, Faller and Hill Coulomb-law experiment reports q = (2.7 +/- 3.1) x 10^-16 in the tested form 1/r^(2+q). Converting only the reported finite interval to exact positive rational exponent bounds and enumerating every positive integer inside them leaves two as the sole compatible exponent.
title: Post-seal experimental agreement of the inverse-square exponent
